scope: Implement EDT-016's existing depth/node-count security requirement as a shared 1000-node-per-page admission boundary; reject malformed/oversized persisted input before UI traversal and before route mutations.

plan_review.reason: The EDT-016 contract already requires depth/node-count limits and malformed nesting rejection. No plan defect was found; 1000 is the implementation's documented finite boundary, not a feature-completion claim.

limit_decision.counting: own enumerable keys of the canonical plain-object node map; stop at limit + 1 without allocating Object.keys
limit_decision.why: A finite admission cap bounds tree, layer, schema, validation and renderer work while leaving substantial headroom over the production database's measured largest page (26 draft / 20 published).
limit_decision.over_limit_behavior: HTTP 413 EDITOR_NODE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED for Editor/page create/save/publish/rollback/duplicate/metadata mutation; oversized page-list records omit the content object and carry editorNodeLimitExceeded=true; client validation fails before walking nodes.

runtime: Added shared MAX_PAGE_NODE_COUNT and hasExcessPageNodes in public/editor-v2/core/hierarchy-limits.js and its declaration.

Applied the guard before schema Object.entries, editor hierarchy/rich-text/accessibility walks, server Publish validation, Editor GET/POST/rollback, Pages list normalization, Pages metadata update, page creation and duplication allocation.
Rejected array-valued node maps as non-canonical on server routes and the direct Publish validator.
Versioned the affected browser module import graph with 20261125-edt016-node-count-limit-v1.
tests: Exact 1000-node page remains valid through client hierarchy/document validation and server Publish validation.
1001-node input is rejected before traversal and does not mutate the model.

Route regressions prove oversized persisted input is refused on Editor load, page list, metadata edit, Save, Publish, rollback, page creation and duplication; D1 fixture rows/revisions/audit stay unchanged on rejected writes.
Save and Publish separation regression remains in the same route suite.
changes.traceability: Added an EDT-016-specific exact source mapping and regenerated docs/evidence/feature-traceability.json; acceptance remains NOT_RECERTIFIED.
